questions.explanation: 根据上下文，“push ourselves out of our comfort zone（走出舒适区）”与“do something that is difficult”语义平行。stretch oneself意为“挑战自身极限，过度劳累”，符合语境。request（请求）、prefer（更喜欢）、remind（提醒）均无法表达出“强迫自己挑战困难”的含义。
questions.supplement:
A(request)：语境句：Passengers are requested to remain seated. 固定搭配：request sb to do sth, make a request.
B(prefer)：语境句：I prefer reading books to playing video games. 固定搭配：prefer A to B, prefer to do rather than do.
C(stretch)：语境句：It's a difficult project, but it will really stretch your abilities. 固定搭配：stretch oneself, stretch out.
D(remind)：语境句：Please remind me to attend the meeting tomorrow. 固定搭配：remind sb of sth, remind sb to do sth.

questions.explanation: 作者在7月29日的舞蹈比赛中“确切地（exactly）”做到了前面提到的“走出舒适区”这件事。exactly that是固定表达，意为“正是那样，就是那件事”。accidentally（偶然地）、regularly（定期地）、hopefully（满怀希望地）均不符合上下文逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(accidentally)：语境句：I accidentally deleted the important document. 固定搭配：meet sb accidentally, discover accidentally.
B(exactly)：语境句：That is exactly what I was trying to say. 固定搭配：do exactly, exactly the same.
C(regularly)：语境句：You should exercise regularly to keep fit. 固定搭配：check regularly, happen regularly.
D(hopefully)：语境句：Hopefully, the weather will be fine tomorrow. 固定搭配：wait hopefully, smile hopefully.

questions.explanation: 作者一开始上课时，并没有参赛的“打算（intention）”。have no intention of doing sth是常见固定搭配，意为“没有做某事的打算”。chance（机会）、charge（负责/费用）、way（方式）均不能与of competing形成符合逻辑的搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(chance)：语境句：I didn't have a chance to speak to her. 固定搭配：by chance, stand a chance.
B(charge)：语境句：He is in charge of the marketing department. 固定搭配：in charge of, take charge.
C(way)：语境句：Can you show me the way to the station? 固定搭配：in a way, by the way.
D(intention)：语境句：I have no intention of changing my mind. 固定搭配：have the intention of, with the intention of.

questions.explanation: 因为作者本来没打算参赛，所以教练花了很多精力“极力劝说/敦促（urging）”作者，最终作者才答应（said yes）。后文的gentle pressure（温和的压力）也呼应了教练的“劝说”。forcing（强迫）语气太重；training（训练）和planning（计划）不符合“劝说参赛”的逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(forcing)：语境句：There is no point in forcing him to do what he hates. 固定搭配：force sb into doing, a driving force.
B(urging)：语境句：At his friend's urging, he applied for the job. 固定搭配：at the urging of, urge sb to do.
C(training)：语境句：The athletes are undergoing strict physical training. 固定搭配：provide training, a training course.
D(planning)：语境句：Careful planning is the key to success. 固定搭配：family planning, urban planning.

questions.explanation: 结合后文“I love the elegance...”，可知作者对交际舞有着深深的“热爱/激情（passion）”。passion for sth表示“对……的强烈爱好或热情”。ambition（野心）、demand（需求）、support（支持）均不符合描述个人爱好的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(passion)：语境句：She has a lifelong passion for classical music. 固定搭配：have a passion for, with passion.
B(ambition)：语境句：His ultimate ambition is to run his own business. 固定搭配：achieve an ambition, full of ambition.
C(demand)：语境句：There is a growing demand for organic food. 固定搭配：in demand, meet the demand.
D(support)：语境句：I would like to thank my family for their unfailing support. 固定搭配：in support of, financial support.

questions.explanation: 作者喜欢参赛者通过走出舒适区所获得的个人“转变/蜕变（transformation）”。根据文章主旨，走出舒适区带来的是个人的成长和改变。success（成功）、recognition（认可）、reward（回报）虽然是褒义，但在强调“走出舒适区带来自身改变”的语境中，transformation最契合。
questions.supplement:
A(success)：语境句：The new product was a huge success in the market. 固定搭配：achieve success, key to success.
B(recognition)：语境句：He received a medal in recognition of his bravery. 固定搭配：in recognition of, gain recognition.
C(reward)：语境句：You deserve a reward for being so helpful. 固定搭配：as a reward, financial reward.
D(transformation)：语境句：The caterpillar underwent a complete transformation into a butterfly. 固定搭配：undergo a transformation, digital transformation.

questions.explanation: 作者之前是一名新闻主播（news anchor），因此她“报道（covered）”了许多世界事件。cover在新闻语境中常作“报道、采访”解。attended（参加）、recorded（记录）、organized（组织）没有体现出新闻工作者的专业特性。
questions.supplement:
A(covered)：语境句：The journalist covered the Olympic Games for the newspaper. 固定搭配：cover a story, cover an event.
B(attended)：语境句：He attended the lecture despite feeling unwell. 固定搭配：attend a meeting, attend school.
C(recorded)：语境句：The temperature was the lowest ever recorded in history. 固定搭配：record a video, keep a record.
D(organized)：语境句：The students organized a charity event to raise money. 固定搭配：highly organized, organize a campaign.

questions.explanation: 在采访中两人“很合得来/建立了良好的沟通（connected）”，于是他教了作者探戈。connect在这里是不及物动词，指“（两人）产生共鸣、建立良好关系”。debated（辩论）、mattered（要紧）、focused（集中）均不符合两人友好互动并进而教学的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(debated)：语境句：The politicians debated the issue passionately. 固定搭配：debate on/over sth, hold a debate.
B(mattered)：语境句：It didn't matter to me what they thought. 固定搭配：make matters worse, as a matter of fact.
C(connected)：语境句：I didn't really connect with my new classmates. 固定搭配：connect with sb, connect to the internet.
D(focused)：语境句：She focused all her attention on the experiment. 固定搭配：focus on, stay focused.

questions.explanation: 著名的舞蹈家教了作者一段30秒的探戈，这促使作者“下定决心（resolve）”去上舞蹈课。resolve that/to do表示“决定、下决心”。admit（承认）、insist（坚持认为/要求）、imagine（想象）与作者由体验进而决定去学习的心路历程不符。
questions.supplement:
A(admit)：语境句：He reluctantly admitted making a foolish mistake. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to.
B(resolve)：语境句：She resolved that she would never speak to him again. 固定搭配：resolve to do sth, resolve a problem.
C(insist)：语境句：He insisted that he was innocent. 固定搭配：insist on doing sth, insist that.
D(imagine)：语境句：Can you imagine living without electricity? 固定搭配：imagine doing sth, hard to imagine.

questions.explanation: 根据后半句的“struggling with the beats and the steps（在节拍和步伐中挣扎）”，可知作者发现学习交际舞是非常“具有挑战性的（challenging）”。amazing（令人惊叹的）、interesting（有趣的）未能体现困难；tiring（令人疲劳的）不如challenging能准确概括学习新技能时的困难感。
questions.supplement:
A(challenging)：语境句：Teaching is a challenging but rewarding profession. 固定搭配：a challenging task, find it challenging.
B(amazing)：语境句：The view from the top of the mountain is amazing. 固定搭配：an amazing experience, truly amazing.
C(interesting)：语境句：It is interesting to note that they share the same hobby. 固定搭配：find sth interesting, interestingly enough.
D(tiring)：语境句：It had been a long, tiring day at the office. 固定搭配：physically tiring, emotionally tiring.

questions.explanation: 虽然作者一开始拒绝参赛（said no），但是在教练几周温和的压力下，他最终“说服（convinced）”了作者。convince sb (to do sth)意为“说服某人做某事”。annoyed（使烦恼）、instructed（指导）、softened（使变软/态度缓和）虽然后者有一定关联，但convinced最直接表达了教练达成目的（让作者参赛）的结果。
questions.supplement:
A(annoyed)：语境句：She was annoyed by his constant interruptions. 固定搭配：be annoyed at/with sb, be annoyed by sth.
B(convinced)：语境句：He convinced me that I needed to take a vacation. 固定搭配：convince sb of sth, convince sb to do sth.
C(instructed)：语境句：The passengers were instructed to put on their life jackets. 固定搭配：instruct sb to do sth, highly instructed.
D(softened)：语境句：Her heart softened when she saw the crying child. 固定搭配：soften the blow, soften one's attitude.

questions.explanation: 比赛当天，作者感到兴奋且“紧张（nervous）”。从后文“I barely remembered anything（我几乎什么都不记得了）”可以看出她是过度紧张导致的大脑一片空白。confident（自信的）、determined（坚定的）、hesitant（犹豫的）均不符合“大脑空白”的前期状态。
questions.supplement:
A(confident)：语境句：She is highly confident in her ability to win. 固定搭配：be confident of/about, feel confident.
B(determined)：语境句：He is determined to overcome all the obstacles. 固定搭配：be determined to do, a determined look.
C(hesitant)：语境句：She took a hesitant step towards the dark room. 固定搭配：be hesitant about, hesitant smile.
D(nervous)：语境句：I always feel nervous before making a public speech. 固定搭配：nervous system, feel nervous.

questions.explanation: 作者在第一轮虽然紧张得不记事，但它对接下来的银组比赛而言，依然是一次很好的“热身（warm-up）”。take-off（起飞）、follow-up（后续行动）、cut-off（截止）均不符合比赛中“第一轮为第二轮做准备”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(warm-up)：语境句：You should always do some warm-up exercises before running. 固定搭配：warm-up exercises, a warm-up match.
B(take-off)：语境句：Please fasten your seatbelts for take-off. 固定搭配：ready for take-off, a smooth take-off.
C(follow-up)：语境句：The doctor arranged a follow-up appointment for the patient. 固定搭配：follow-up action, follow-up study.
D(cut-off)：语境句：The cut-off date for registration is next Friday. 固定搭配：cut-off point, cut-off date.

questions.explanation: 作者体会到的乐趣超乎“预期（expected）”。more than expected 是固定表达，意为“比预期的多”。scheduled（安排）、promised（承诺）、recommended（推荐）在语义上均不搭配“体会到的乐趣（fun）”。
questions.supplement:
A(scheduled)：语境句：The flight is scheduled to arrive at 10 PM. 固定搭配：as scheduled, be scheduled for.
B(promised)：语境句：He did not deliver what he had promised. 固定搭配：as promised, keep a promise.
C(expected)：语境句：The test was much easier than I had expected. 固定搭配：more than expected, as expected.
D(recommended)：语境句：It is highly recommended that you book your tickets in advance. 固定搭配：highly recommended, strongly recommended.

questions.explanation: 作者真正感到自豪的是自己“学会了/掌握了（picked up）”一些新东西（即交际舞）。pick up 意为“学会（非正规地）”。come across（偶然发现）、work out（解决/锻炼）、set aside（留出/不顾）均不符合“学习新技能”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(come across)：语境句：I came across some old photos while cleaning the room. 固定搭配：come across as, come across sb.
B(worked out)：语境句：Things worked out quite well in the end. 固定搭配：work out a plan, work out at the gym.
C(set aside)：语境句：She set aside some money every month for her holiday. 固定搭配：set aside time, set aside money.
D(picked up)：语境句：He picked up French while he was living in Paris. 固定搭配：pick up a skill, pick up the phone.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a place or situation where one feels safe or at ease
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词out of的宾语，与our搭配，表示“我们的舒适区”。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to step out of your comfort zone to grow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 走出舒适区对成长很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: push ourselves out of our comfort zone

vocab_pack.term: push oneself out of one's comfort zone
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: push ourselves out of our comfort zone
vocab_pack.definition_en: to force oneself to do something unfamiliar or uncomfortable in order to grow
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作谓语，一般现在时，主语we，push为动词原形，ourselves为反身代词。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should push yourself out of your comfort zone if you want to improve.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你想提高，就应该迫使自己走出舒适区。
vocab_pack.from_passage: push ourselves out of our comfort zone

vocab_pack.definition_en: to extend one's abilities or effort beyond the usual limits
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作谓语，一般现在时，主语we，stretch为动词原形，ourselves为反身代词。
vocab_pack.example_en: To achieve more, you need to stretch yourself regularly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 为了取得更多成就，你需要经常挑战自己。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we stretch ourselves to do something

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive instruction in a subject or activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动名词短语，作started的宾语，表示“开始上课”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to take lessons in French before her trip.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决定在旅行前上法语课。
vocab_pack.from_passage: started taking lessons

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have no plan or desire to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时，had是have的过去式，of后接动名词competing。
vocab_pack.example_en: I have no intention of attending the meeting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我不打算参加那个会议。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had no intention of competing

vocab_pack.definition_en: strong advice or persuasion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不可数名词，作介词from的宾语，a lot of urging表示“大量催促”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Despite his mother's urging, he refused to eat vegetables.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管母亲催促，他还是拒绝吃蔬菜。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a lot of urging from my instructor

vocab_pack.definition_en: a strong liking or enthusiasm for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语（My passion for...），名词短语，表示“对舞厅舞的热爱”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has a passion for classical music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她热爱古典音乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My passion for ballroom dancing

vocab_pack.definition_en: a significant change in oneself, especially in character or behavior
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作love的宾语，与elegance并列，名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Travel often leads to personal transformation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行常常带来个人蜕变。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the elegance and the personal transformation

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who presents news on television or radio
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语（I was a news anchor），名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She worked as a news anchor for ten years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她做了十年的新闻主播。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was a news anchor

vocab_pack.definition_en: to report on an event or topic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式，及物动词，宾语many world events。
vocab_pack.example_en: The journalist covered the election campaign.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位记者报道了竞选活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: covered many world events

vocab_pack.definition_en: to ask someone questions in order to get information, especially for a job or news
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式，及物动词，宾语celebrities。
vocab_pack.example_en: The reporter interviewed the famous actor after the show.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 记者在演出后采访了那位著名演员。
vocab_pack.from_passage: interviewed celebrities

vocab_pack.definition_en: very successful, respected, and admired
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语，修饰dancer，表示“杰出的舞蹈家”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is a distinguished professor in the field of physics.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他是物理学领域一位杰出的教授。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a distinguished dancer

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a rapport or good relationship with someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式，不及物动词（搭配in the interview），表示“在采访中很投缘”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two speakers really connected during the debate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 两位演讲者在辩论中产生了很好的共鸣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We really connected in the interview

vocab_pack.definition_en: to instruct someone in a skill or subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式（taught），双宾语结构：间接宾语me，直接宾语a 30-second tango。
vocab_pack.example_en: My grandfather taught me how to fish.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我祖父教了我如何钓鱼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: taught me a 30-second tango

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a firm decision to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在make sb do结构中，resolve为省略to的不定式，后接that从句，表示“使我下定决心”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He resolved that he would never give up.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他下定决心绝不放弃。
vocab_pack.from_passage: making me resolve that I would take lessons

vocab_pack.definition_en: individual instruction, usually one-on-one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作started的宾语，名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She takes private lessons in piano every week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每周上钢琴私教课。
vocab_pack.from_passage: started private lessons with Andriy

vocab_pack.definition_en: difficult in a way that tests one's ability
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语（how challenging...is），形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The final exam was very challenging.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 期末考试非常有挑战性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how challenging learning ballroom dancing is

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have difficulty doing or dealing with something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词短语，作伴随状语，表示“在节奏和舞步方面挣扎”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students struggle with math in high school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 很多高中生在数学上感到吃力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: struggling with the beats and the steps

vocab_pack.definition_en: to sign up for or take part in a contest
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动名词短语，作mention的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to enter the competition despite her nerves.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管紧张，她还是决定参加比赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: entering a competition

vocab_pack.definition_en: mild or subtle persuasion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词after的宾语，名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: With a little gentle pressure, he agreed to help.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在一点温和的劝说下，他同意帮忙。
vocab_pack.from_passage: weeks of gentle pressure

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to believe or do something through reasoning or persuasion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式，及物动词，接me。
vocab_pack.example_en: I convinced my friend to join the club.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我说服了我朋友加入俱乐部。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he convinced me

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: On the day of the competition
vocab_pack.definition_en: on the specific day when something happens
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作时间状语，On the day of后接名词the competition，表示“在比赛那天”。
vocab_pack.example_en: On the day of the exam, she felt well-prepared.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考试那天，她感觉准备充分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: On the day of the competition

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling enthusiastic and eager

section_2_word_form.passage:
China completed on Monday the world's longest expressway tunnel (隧道) in Xinjiang, marking an important milestone. Once it becomes [56], the 22.13km Tianshan Shengli Tunnel will significantly shorten the travel time [57] the Tianshan Mountains, boost connections between northern and southern Xinjiang, [58] help promote the economy of the region greatly, a core area on the Silk Road Economic Belt.
The tunneling work started in April 2020. The working team had to overcome many difficulties and continuously innovate [59] challenges such as complicated geological conditions. With the construction site [60] close to the Tianshan No. 1 glacier (冰川) and the Urumqi water source protection areas, the construction needed very careful handling. That was [61] the team was required to maintain exceptionally high ecological protection standards.
For the first time in China, tunnel boring machines [62] to construct a road tunnel, which contributed to [63] in the constructing time. Cui Jingchuan, president of the construction company, said all of the machinery used was domestically developed. "We [64] the technological monopoly (垄断) of foreign countries in this field and taken the lead in innovation."
The regional government said the new tunnel will boost the flow and communication of people between northern and southern Xinjiang, [65] for more career and development opportunities.

questions.explanation: 句意：一旦它投入使用（变得可运作）。become是连系动词，其后需接形容词作表语。operation的形容词形式是operational，表示“可运转的，投入使用的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(operational)：语境句：The new airport runway is now fully operational. 固定搭配：become operational, fully operational。原词operation其它变形：operate(v.), operator(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：缩短穿越天山的旅行时间。天山是山脉，隧道是从山体内部穿过，因此使用介词through（穿过，表示从内部穿过）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(through)：语境句：The train went through a long dark tunnel. 固定搭配：go through, read through。其它常见搭配：travel through, pass through。

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构发现，shorten..., boost..., [58] help promote... 三者是并列的谓语动词，共同作will的宾语。表示顺承或并列关系，填连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He opened the door, turned on the light, and sat down. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。其它常见并列连词：but, or, so。

questions.explanation: 句意：团队必须克服许多困难，不断创新“以应对”复杂地质条件等挑战。此处表目的，应使用动词不定式to address（解决、应对）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to address)：语境句：The government has introduced new policies to address the housing problem. 固定搭配：address a problem, address an issue。原词address其它变形：address(n. 地址/演讲)。

questions.explanation: 此处为“with + 宾语 + 宾语补足语”复合结构。宾语是the construction site，与动词locate（使坐落于）之间是被动关系，因此使用过去分词located。
questions.supplement: 正确形(located)：语境句：The company is conveniently located near the subway station. 固定搭配：be located in/at, centrally located。原词locate其它变形：location(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：因为靠近冰川和水源保护区，施工需要非常小心。这“就是为什么（why）”团队被要求保持极高环保标准的原因。引导表语从句，并在从句中作原因状语，用why。
questions.supplement: 正确形(why)：语境句：He didn't pass the exam, and that was why he looked so sad. 固定搭配：That is why..., the reason why...。

questions.explanation: 句意：在中国，隧道掘进机首次“被使用”于公路隧道的建设。主语tunnel boring machines与employ（使用/雇佣）是被动关系。结合语境（整个工程的背景是过去发生的事，如started in 2020），应使用一般过去时的被动语态，且主语是复数，故填were employed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were employed)：语境句：New methods were employed to speed up the production process. 固定搭配：employ sb to do, employ a method。原词employ其它变形：employer(n.), employee(n.), employment(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：这有助于“减少”施工时间。contribute to中的to是介词，其后需接名词或动名词。此处有in the constructing time，所以需填入名词reduction构成“a reduction in...”或复数“reductions”（填a reduction最标准，也可填reduction）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a reduction)：语境句：We have noticed a significant reduction in air pollution this year. 固定搭配：a reduction in, price reduction。原词reduce其它变形：reduce(v.), reduced(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：“我们已经打破了国外在该领域的技术垄断...”。根据句中并列结构“and taken (the lead)”，可以推断前面的时态也是现在完成时，主语为We，故填have broken。
questions.supplement: 正确形(have broken)：语境句：Scientists have broken new ground in the fight against cancer. 固定搭配：break a record, break a promise。原词break其它变形：broke(过去式), broken(过去分词), breakthrough(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：新隧道将促进南北疆人员的流动和交流，（从而）为更多的职业和发展机会“提供可能/创造条件”。此处作自然而然的结果状语，主语the new tunnel与allow是主动关系，用现在分词allowing (allow for意为“考虑到，使...成为可能”)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(allowing)：语境句：It rained heavily for days, causing floods and allowing no time for rescue. 固定搭配：allow for, allow sb to do sth。原词allow其它变形：allowance(n.), allowable(adj.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to finish doing or making something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式（completed）作谓语，表示动作已完成；主语 China 为第三人称单数，但过去式不受人称影响。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team completed the tunnel ahead of schedule.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队提前完成了隧道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: China completed on Monday the world's longest expressway tunnel

vocab_pack.definition_en: to celebrate or indicate a significant stage in development
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 标志着一个重要的里程碑
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语（marking...）作伴随状语，表示主句动作同时发生的结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new law marked an important milestone in environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部新法律标志了环境保护的一个重要里程碑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: marking an important milestone

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start working or being used
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 it (指隧道) 为第三人称单数，谓语用 becomes；become 为系动词，后接形容词 operational。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new factory will become operational next month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家新工厂将于下个月投入运营。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Once it becomes operational

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something shorter in length or time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般将来时 will 后的动词原形，与 will 共同构成谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This shortcut will shorten the journey by 30 minutes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这条近路将把行程缩短30分钟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: will significantly shorten the travel time

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that is large or important enough to be noticed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词 shorten，表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: The number of tourists has increased significantly this year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 今年的游客数量显著增加。
vocab_pack.from_passage: will significantly shorten the travel time

vocab_pack.definition_en: to increase or improve something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般将来时 will 后的动词原形，与 will 共同构成谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy will boost economic growth.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策将促进经济增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: boost connections between northern and southern Xinjiang

vocab_pack.definition_en: to support or encourage something to happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在 help promote 结构中，help 后接省略 to 的动词不定式，promote 为原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating habits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项活动旨在促进健康的饮食习惯。
vocab_pack.from_passage: help promote the economy of the region

vocab_pack.definition_en: a central or most important part of an area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作同位语，补充说明 the region 的性质；core area 前有不定冠词 a，但此处提取词条时不包含冠词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The core area of the city is full of historical buildings.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市的中心区域遍布历史建筑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a core area on the Silk Road Economic Belt

vocab_pack.definition_en: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: had to 后接动词原形，表示过去必须做某事；overcome 为不规则动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She overcame many obstacles to achieve her dream.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她克服了许多障碍实现了梦想。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had to overcome many difficulties

vocab_pack.definition_en: to introduce new ideas or methods
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在 to innovate 中，innovate 为动词原形，与 to 构成不定式短语，作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Companies must constantly innovate to stay competitive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司必须不断创新以保持竞争力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: continuously innovate to address challenges

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try to deal with a problem or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to address 中的原形动词，与 to 构成目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government must address the issue of pollution.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府必须处理污染问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to address challenges such as complicated geological conditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: a difficult task or problem
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式 challenges 作宾语，前无冠词，泛指多个困难。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project faces many technical challenges.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目面临许多技术挑战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: address challenges such as complicated geological conditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: the physical characteristics of the earth in a certain area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词 such as 的宾语，与 complicated 一起构成名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The geological conditions in this region make mining difficult.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该地区的地质条件使得采矿困难。
vocab_pack.from_passage: complicated geological conditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: to place something in a particular position
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词 located 作宾语补足语，表示被动含义：the construction site is located close to...。句中为 with + 名词 + 过去分词结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school is located in the center of the city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校位于市中心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With the construction site located close to the Tianshan No.1 glacier

vocab_pack.definition_en: near; not far from
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，与 located 搭配作状语，表示位置关系。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel is close to the train station.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家酒店靠近火车站。
vocab_pack.from_passage: located close to the Tianshan No.1 glacier

vocab_pack.definition_en: a natural source of water, such as a river or lake
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作后置定语修饰 protection areas，表示“水源保护区域”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The river is an important water source for the city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这条河是城市的重要水源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the Urumqi water source protection areas

vocab_pack.definition_en: an area designated to protect natural resources or wildlife
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式 protection areas，与 water source 一起构成复合名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The wetland is a protected area for migratory birds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这片湿地是候鸟的保护区。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the Urumqi water source protection areas

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of dealing with something in a careful way to avoid damage
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作宾语，前有形容词 very 修饰；handling 为动名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: These fragile items require careful handling.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些易碎物品需要小心处理。
vocab_pack.from_passage: very careful handling

vocab_pack.definition_en: must do something because of a rule, law, or necessity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态一般过去时，was required to 后接动词原形 maintain；主语 the team 为第三人称单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: All students are required to wear uniforms.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 所有学生都必须穿校服。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the team was required to maintain exceptionally high ecological protection standards

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep something at a certain level or in good condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to maintain 中的原形动词，与 to 一起作主语补足语（was required to maintain）。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保持健康的生活方式很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to maintain exceptionally high ecological protection standards

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely; more than usual
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰形容词 high，表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is exceptionally talented in music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在音乐方面异常有天赋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: exceptionally high ecological protection standards

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of protecting the natural environment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作定语修饰 standards，表示“生态保护标准”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Ecological protection is essential for sustainable development.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 生态保护对可持续发展至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ecological protection standards

vocab_pack.definition_en: a machine used to excavate tunnels through various ground conditions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，作主语；boring 为动名词修饰 machine。
vocab_pack.example_en: The tunnel boring machine can drill through solid rock.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 隧道掘进机可以钻透坚硬岩石。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tunnel boring machines were employed to construct a road tunnel

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use something for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态一般过去时，were employed 表示被用于；employ 的过去分词作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: New technologies were employed to improve efficiency.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 采用了新技术以提高效率。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tunnel boring machines were employed to construct a road tunnel

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help cause something or be a factor in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，contributed to 中的 contributed 为过去式，to 为介词，后接名词短语 a reduction。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise contributes to good health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 定期锻炼有助于健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: contributed to a reduction in the constructing time

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of making something smaller or less in amount
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词 to 的宾语，前有不定冠词 a。
vocab_pack.example_en: There has been a significant reduction in costs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 成本已经显著降低。
vocab_pack.from_passage: contributed to a reduction in the constructing time

vocab_pack.definition_en: produced or created within one's own country
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作表语，与 was 一起构成被动语态；developed 为过去分词形容词化。
vocab_pack.example_en: The vaccine was domestically developed and produced.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种疫苗是自主研发和生产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: all of the machinery used was domestically developed

vocab_pack.definition_en: to end the exclusive control or dominance of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 have broken，broken 为过去分词；the technological monopoly 为宾语，其中 technological 为形容词修饰 monopoly。
vocab_pack.example_en: Competition has broken the monopoly of the state-owned company.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 竞争打破了国有公司的垄断。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We have broken the technological monopoly of foreign countries

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be the best or most advanced in a particular area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 have taken，taken 为过去分词；the lead 为固定名词短语，in 为介词，后接名词 innovation。
vocab_pack.example_en: This company has taken the lead in renewable energy research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司在可再生能源研究方面处于领先地位。
vocab_pack.from_passage: taken the lead in innovation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something possible; to consider or include something in planning
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 允许，使…成为可能；考虑到
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 allowing for 作伴随状语，表示主动意义，逻辑主语为 the new tunnel。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flexible design allows for future expansion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 灵活的设计为未来扩建提供了可能。
vocab_pack.from_passage: allowing for more career and development opportunities
